title: KlickYC
tagline: KlickYC is a KYC SDK that allows you to identify a user in just a few clicks using open-banking.
description:
If it's the first connexion, you will  have to do your KYC, but it will be the last time you have to do it.  Because once you've done it, you will be invited to select your Ethereum Name Service and connect your bank account. This way, your KYC will be linked to your ENS and your bank account, which make it really unique. We will take the first transaction from your bank account and hash it with your name. Then we will store your ENS with the hash on Filecoin.
Like that, when you will have to do a new KYC, you will be able to select your ENS and connect your bank account to simply do the KYC, because we will compare that your ENS is still linked to the hash of the first transaction of your account. 
Our solution is a SDK so using npm, everybody can implement our solution on his app, to simplify KYC to everybody.
how_its_made:
This project use Ethereum Name Service as a on-chain identity, and when he connects his wallet, we will verify than this address is really the ones linked to ENS.
We also used LightHouse from Filecoin to store data. We requested an API and use the code to push some data on IPFS using the lighthouse sdk.
